706920101.text: Wow, young Knight, looks like you've brought our great hero over!

706920102.text: It's our Honorary Knight and the Helper in White! Greetings!

706920103.text: Mika and... a friend from Natlan? What are you guys doing here?

706920104.text: We're here to get the word out about something called the Saury-Saury Scout. We think it's something adventurers will find really useful.

706920105.text: It combines the mechanical core of the Scouting Buddy that Amber brought back from Sumeru with the adorable appearance of the little saurian toy my friends from Natlan gave me.

706920106.text: Scouting Buddy... Oh, yeah, Paimon remembers!

706920107.text: Just like the Scouting Buddies from Sumeru, the Saury-Saury Scout can be used to perform monster recon and survey unfamiliar terrain.

706920108.text: But due to our focus being on the latter, the Saury-Saury Scout is designed with a greater emphasis on controllability and precision of movement.

706920109.text: ...Are you interested in taking it on a test flight, Honorary Knight?

706920112.text: Huh? Perhaps I was a little bit nervous just now...

706920113.text: That must be it... I could swear I was more relaxed around you before.

706920114.text: It's just that I've been hearing so many stories about you from friends in other nations lately — your deeds are getting more and more exceptional...

706920115.text: Every time I think about how I need to be helpful and not get in your way, I can't help but tense up again.

706920116.text: That's such a Mika thing to say...

706920117.text: You're doing very well, young Knight!

706920118.text: #Sometimes, in Natlan, when a warrior from our tribe runs into {NICKNAME}, they get so excited they just start blabbering. I've even seen folks get so overwhelmed, they can't get a single word out!

706920119.text: #As someone who works alongside {NICKNAME}, you're basically a legend yourself. There's no need for you to be nervous, even when talking to our chief!

706920120.text: That's right! You should have more faith in yourself, Mika!

706920121.text: Hmm... I've never really thought about it from that point of view before...

706920122.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, if you test out the Saury-Saury Scout and find it makes the grade, then we'll know for sure that it's a reliable, adorable mechanism that can be a big help to all sorts of adventurers!
